summary.en: Series resistances add; the same current flows through each.

summary.en: An open circuit carries no current; a short has (almost) no voltage across it.
summary.fr: Un circuit ouvert ne laisse passer aucun courant ; un court-circuit n’a (presque) aucune tension à ses bornes.
